label_tips.Growth in reported financials: All four: Piotroski F-Score 5 or more (all nine F-Score checks filed), reported financials score 65 or more, valuation metrics score 60 or more, and 3-month price change above the Nifty 50.
label_tips.Incomplete data: Meets every other condition of Growth in reported financials or Profit trend change, but one input that label needs is not available: the Piotroski F-Score (Growth in reported financials) or the profit trend of the filed annual results (Profit trend change). Neither label is given without its input.
label_tips.Stronger current financials: Piotroski F-Score 5 or more and reported financials score 60 or more.
label_tips.Valuation metrics below reference: Valuation metrics score 65 or more: P/S, P/CF and P/FCF below the reference values this page uses, with the 3-month price change relative to the Nifty 50 available.
label_tips.Profit trend change: All three: reported financials score below 52; 3-month price change above the Nifty 50; and the latest filed annual result shows a profit turn against the year before (a loss or zero profit turned into a profit, or profit up with net margin up 2 points or more) with positive operating cash flow in the latest year. Not shown when those annual results are not filed.
label_tips.Limited reported financials: Fewer than two of F-Score, P/S, P/CF, P/FCF and debt/equity are available, so no reported financials score.
label_tips.Mixed indicators: None of the other summary rules applies.
label_tips.Insufficient data: Neither the reported financials score nor the valuation metrics score could be calculated.
